query:
SELECT COALESCE(
                    (SELECT price
                     FROM price_history
                     WHERE token_id = $1 AND created_at <= $2
                     ORDER BY created_at DESC, block_number DESC, tx_index DESC, log_index DESC
                     LIMIT 1),
                    (SELECT price
                     FROM price_history
                     WHERE token_id = $1
                     ORDER BY created_at ASC, block_number ASC, tx_index ASC, log_index ASC
                     LIMIT 1)
                ) as price
